senses.gloss: m. (חָלַל) hollowed; pipe, channel.—Pl. חֲלוּלִים, חֲלוּלִין. Sifra K’dosh. Par. 1; Yalk. Lev. 604 the idols are called אֱלִילִים, על שם שהם ח׳ because they are hollow.—
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 60b:1">Ber. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ ח׳</he> Ms. F. a. oth. (ed. <he>חֲלָלִים</he>) full of channels (bowels &c.).
